attchmntText: GLOBE ENTERPRISES (INDIA) LIMITED has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Globe Enterprises India Limited filed an investor presentation regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Consolidated total revenue for Q2 FY27 stood at 21,028.35 Lakhs, showing 32.62% year-on-year growth. EBITDA was 1,176.15 Lakhs, up 24.50%. For H1 FY27, consolidated total revenue reached 39,511.34 Lakhs, with 28.70% growth. EBITDA was 2,135.27 Lakhs, reflecting 22.12% growth. The company noted cautious recovery in the textile industry. It highlighted integration with Globe Denwash Private Limited and expansion into technical textiles and chemicals. The presentation included management commentary from Chairman Bhavik Parikh and CEO Bhavin Parikh. Financial snapshots detailed revenue, EBITDA, and profit before tax for both consolidated and standalone bases.

attchmntText: GLOBE ENTERPRISES (INDIA) LIMITED has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 06, 2026, titled "Press Release on Unaudited Financial Results of Globe Enterprises (India) Limited for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026".
